title: Chimila language
extract: Chimila, also known as Ette Taara, is a Chibchan language of Colombia, spoken by the Chimila people, who live between the lower Magdalena River, the Sierra Nevada de Santa Maria and the Cesar River. Chimila was historically grouped with the Malibu languages, but then it was classified as a Chibchan language.
